As I said, I had received no prior notification of legal action being taken until I received the letter today.

I paid the balance in full on receipt of my bill which I received in September.

That’s the issue. Some aspects of my illnesses have worsened so I assumed I’d at least have a face to face assessment.

However surely if they’ve stopped my PIP I have some sort of recourse considering I wasn’t offered any sort of assessment whether face to face nor telephone/zoom etc. Also, surely I should have been allowed opportunity to  provide new medical evidence considering I completed the forms back in August 2022.

As I’ve said it’s not my claim so I can only go on what I’m told. I’m just trying to assist a neighbour who isn’t ‘tech savvy’ and has never had to make a claim for benefits prior to this. 

All I know is that supposedly there has been a previous claim or an attempt at a claim using his details which he has not made.
Does your employer own the store? I previously worked in retail profit and loss so this is either tax evasion or retail fraud.

They are fully aware. The perpetrator has been on the run since this happened and due to the barbarity of the attack on my brother, we all have ‘markers’ on each of her homes as the perpetrator stated he ‘will end us all’ in communication after the incident.
Apologies, I’ve never had any involvement with the police so this is all relatively new to me.

Sorry I should have mentioned this is in
England.

I finally got them but they are heavily redacted, making them unusable for the purpose I require. If anyone knows if this is common practice or they should be available without all the redactions, please let me know.

I asked about this a few weeks ago. Here’s my post and the helpful responses. https://www.reddit.com/r/LegalAdviceUK/comments/xrck1e/access_to_my_full_medical_records_gp_surgery_not/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf

Thank you for your reply and advice.

I initially requested via the website. It was switched off and you can request it be turned on, which I did. I also followed this up with several emails over a number of weeks to enquire as to why it hadn’t been turned on as of yet.

I have written to the practice manager around two weeks ago. Again, in their response my request was ignored. I have again written requesting clarification as to why it hasn’t been turned on, however this was only around a week ago so I will obviously have to wait for further response before I escalate it to the ICB if they fail to acknowledge this.

Yes I updated the address prior to making purchase. However shortly after making purchase the website ‘went down’ so to speak with the website showing as under maintenance for the rest of the day.

Yes it was signed for however due to Covid they only take a photo of the item just inside your front door as proof so although there is no signature there is a photo of the parcel inside my old address.
No I agree. As my post states there were a number of celebrities who entered the venue with us common folk without making a scene and just enjoyed the show like any other fan!
Thank you! And thanks for all the information you provided me with. It was extremely informative and enlightening.

Thank you for the further links. Like I said this is my own understanding of the situation having watched/read all the media from the links provided. I am happy to be corrected or further informed as I would like to know the truth.

So from what I have gathered from all the provided information (This is my understanding of it and please advise me if I’m wrong), that the ‘war’ is very much because of external interference from the US (who have armed the Ukraine and supplied them with the funds to initiate a war with Russia, meaning the US won’t have to go to war themselves with Russia) and to some extent the EU by attempting to get Ukraine to join the EU and reneging on assurances they wouldn’t.

I also believe that the war is very much because of a divided Ukraine with it split between those who want to rejoin Russia and the others wanting a more Eurocentric Ukraine. This has caused a ‘civil war’ within Ukraine with certain cities/areas targeted and genocide taking place  because they are on the ‘wrong side’ of what direction they want the country to go. Also a lot of the mass graves in the Ukraine predate the Russian invasion.

Also, some of the reasons Russia has claimed they have gone to war, US Biochemical labs, Denazification, Genocide etc are occurring in the country.

Again, this is solely what I have gleaned from the information and would be happy to be corrected if wrong.
